scoring_justification: Work function extraction from FLAPW logs is not feasible to recompute in the scoring environment; result-level comparison against paper's gold values with tolerance and monotonic trend check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold work function values and tolerance for comparing agent CSV
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: clean W 4.77 eV, Cs/W 2.6 Å 2.77 eV, 2.75 Å 2.55 eV, 2.9 Å 2.28 eV. Tolerance ±0.2 eV accounts for implementation differences in FLAPW codes.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from paper text (abstract and results).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are verbatim from the published paper.

outputs.description: Work function values for the clean W(001) five-layer slab and for Cs c(2×2)/W(001) at three Cs-W separations (2.6, 2.75, 2.90 Å). The checker compares the reported work_function values against reference results with appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker performs a result-level comparison (T0) of the agent-reported work functions to the paper's calculated values, within a tolerance appropriate for different FLAPW implementations.

steps.description: Check that the CSV contains the four required systems, and the reported work_function values are within ±0.2 eV of the paper's gold values, and the monotonic trend holds (Cs_W_2.9 < Cs_W_2.75 < Cs_W_2.6 < clean_W_5layer).
